name: 5578-solodecode-dsv2lite-1gpu
model: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat, bf16, ~31 GB of weights, ungated on the Hub, ships its own modeling code.
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, one node, one GPU.
parallelism: tp1. No tensor, pipeline, expert or data parallelism.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, warmup the first 15%, bounded at 120 requests with a 1200 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, exactly 512 prompt tokens and exactly 512 generated tokens, both stdev 0, seed 42.
purpose: A single-user chat assistant on one H100, streaming 512-token replies to 512-token prompts, one request at a time.
launch:
# One H100 serving DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat to one client at a time, 512 in / 512 out.
model-path: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat
trust-remote-code: true
tp-size: 1
attention-backend: fa3
disable-radix-cache: true

# LOAD-BEARING, NOT COSMETIC: the checkpoint advertises 163840 positions, and the request table
# the engine allocates on the device is (max requests) x (context length + 8) int32 -- at the
# advertised window that is terabytes and the server never starts. 512 + 512 fits 4096.
context-length: 4096
mem-fraction-static: 0.85
random-seed: 42
